notes.title: Patch Note 1.02
notes.content:
Finally! 
Chinese voiceovers are in.
Also fixed a bunch of bugs :P
To celebrate the new content launch, we started a 10% discount for everyone, Enjoy!

[spoiler]Added option to skip the prologue
Repaired some models
Fixed issues relating to loading a saved game or new game, including placeable items and NPC/game progress
Fixed animations and character movements
Removed debug button to pause countdown timer
Updated Demo puzzle page
Fixed character model issue for after jumping off the building
Replaced illegible pictures
Fixed issue with “read view” displaying placeholder text
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.01
notes.content:
Midnight hotfix!

- Show the version number on the title screen
[spoiler] 
- Fixed body mesh clipping while using binoculars
- Fixed the email notification sound not stopping when leaving the living room
- Fixed an issue with temple doors not opening after loading the game
- Fixed an issue where police email addresses, when uppercased, could not be logged in
- Fixed an issue when pressing P causes HUD to disappear and clock to pause
- Fixed a LOD issue at the dock area
[/spoiler]

If you have any further feedback, don't hesitate to tell us in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cj2EYpY]Discord Server[/url]!

Have fun detectives XD
